[LIMP.12.1] **Every compilation imports the built-in module.** The compiler
must import it into every source file it compiles, and no program can decline
it. The module declares the built-in schemas of [LIMP.12.2] and nothing else:
no rule, constant, unit or service.

The built-in module is not a library ([LIMP.3.3.2]). It has no path, so no
import names it and no `as` alias renames it ([LIMP.2.1.7]), and no dotted name
reaches into it ([LGRA.22.9]). Its schemas are in scope by their bare names in
every file.
